releaseTitle: SOREX / Swarix v2.9 – AI Recommendation, Smart Typo & Lyrics Search, Voice Search
changelog:
1. Advanced Hybrid AI Music Recommendation Engine (Content-Based + Collaborative + User Taste Profile + Session Context)
2. Strict Language & Mood Consistency (Hindi Romantic -> Hindi Romantic, never abruptly jumping to clashing genres)
3. Fixed Listening History & Search Separation: typing/displaying search results never creates history records; only actual playback records ID, duration, completion %, and skip status
4. Multilingual & Devanagari Lyrics-Based Search Engine with matched lyric snippet display
5. Typo-Tolerant Smart Search Engine (Levenshtein distance <= 2)
6. Upgraded Microphone Voice Search with RECORD_AUDIO permission and Hindi/English speech recognition
7. Extensible Query-by-Humming / Audio Fingerprint Provider Interface
